    right="Item 3+"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Sapling Shield](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1860)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 22

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** 2
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Base Shield** [Buckler](/Shields.aspx?ID=1), [Tower Shield](/Shields.aspx?ID=4)
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This surprisingly weighty, though well-balanced, wooden [buckler](/Shields.aspx?ID=1) is emblazoned with the image of a sapling. The sapling withers as the shield takes damage.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561))    **Effect** The buckler expands, with the sapling image growing into a mighty oak tree. The buckler becomes a [tower shield](/Shields.aspx?ID=4), gaining the corresponding AC bonus, Speed penalty, and ability to [Take Cover](/Actions.aspx?ID=90). It keeps the same Hit Points and Broken Threshold, but its Hardness and Bulk increase by 2 in this form. The shield remains in this form until you Activate it again to revert it to a buckler.

</column>

This surprisingly weighty, though well-balanced, wooden buckler is emblazoned with the image of a sapling. The sapling withers as the shield takes damage.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> envision;     **Effect** The buckler expands, with the sapling image growing into a mighty oak tree. The buckler becomes a [tower shield](/Shields.aspx?ID=20), gaining the corresponding AC bonus, Speed penalty, and ability to [Take Cover](/Rules.aspx?ID=2556). It keeps the same Hit Points and Broken Threshold, but its Hardness and Bulk increase by 2 in this form. The shield remains in this form until you Activate it again to revert it to a buckler.

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 109 **Price** 50 gp **Usage** held in 1 hand **Bulk** L **Activate**([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) --- A layer of vapor swirls just below the surface of this glass container holding a large, dried heap of fungal-encrusted seaweed. You can throw the phial up to 30 feet when you Activate it. When opened or thrown, a Medium [sargassum heap](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3171) effigy reconstitutes to release a hallucinogenic cloud in a 15-foot emanation, forcing each creature to attempt a DC 20 Fortitude save. On a failure, a creature rolls 1d4 to determine what it is hallucinating for the next 1d4 rounds (unless otherwise noted). At the beginning of their turn, an affected creature attempts a new save.
  1. The target thinks they are sinking through the floor. It falls [prone](/Conditions.aspx?ID=88) and spends 1 action on its next turn flailing its limbs as if attempting to swim.
  2. The target thinks an item they are holding turns into a viper. The target [Releases](/Actions.aspx?ID=2300) the item and spends its next turn [fleeing](/Conditions.aspx?ID=74) from it.
  3. The target thinks they have shrunk to 1/10 their normal size. For 1 round, it is [slowed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=92) 2, [enfeebled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=71) 2, and takes a –10-foot status penalty to its Speed.
  4. The target believes they are melting. It drops everything it’s holding and becomes slowed 2 and [clumsy](/Conditions.aspx?ID=61) 2 for 1 round.
**Craft Requirements** Supply the corpse of a [sargassum heap](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3171).

<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Grand Bazaar](/Sources.aspx?ID=100) pg. 80

**Price** 250 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn armor

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Base Armor** [Explorer's Clothing](/Armor.aspx?ID=2)
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Each _Sarkorian god-caller garb_ is emblazoned with a unique sigil of a particular Sarkorian deity and adorned with symbols sacred to Sarkorian god callers, the summoners and religious leaders of Sarkoris. These _+1 [explorer's clothing](/Armor.aspx?ID=2)_ outfits look as if they were stitched together from multiple types of animals, featuring feathers, fur, leather, and scales.

 When you cast a 3-action summoning spell while wearing this armor, the summoned creature gains a magical sigil that matches the one on the armor. As long as it is within 30 feet of you, the summoned creature gains a +1 status bonus to AC. If it ever moves farther than 30 feet from you, the sigil fades and the creature loses the status bonus to AC, even if it later comes within 30 feet of you again.

<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 17"
    pfs="Limited"
>
[Sash of Books](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2529)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Stolen Fate</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=137" />
<trait label="Apex" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=10" />
<trait label="Divination" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=47" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #192: Worst of All Possible Worlds](/Sources.aspx?ID=203) pg. 70

**Price** 15,000 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn garment

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This elegant black sash features stylized crimson books embroidered at either end and a set of simple tassels. While wearing the sash, you feel as if you have a better understanding of the people and life around you. You gain a +3 item bonus to [Society](/Skills.aspx?ID=14) checks.

 When you invest the sash, you either increase your Intelligence score by 2 or increase it to 18, whichever would give you a higher score.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> envision;  **Frequency** once per minute;   **Effect** You focus on a creature you can see and attempt to gain an instinctual understanding of the creature. You attempt a check to [Recall Knowledge](/Actions.aspx?ID=26) about the creature, rolling twice and taking the higher result. If you roll a critical failure on this check, you get a failure instead. Regardless of the result, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to attack rolls against the creature and to your AC and saving throws against attacks and effects from the creature for 1 minute. This bonus increases to +2 if you critically succeeded your check to Recall Knowledge.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> command, envision;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You become keenly aware of your surroundings and become able to anticipate dangers. You gain the effects of [_foresight_](/Spells.aspx?ID=127).

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

This humble sash can be worn around the waist or across the chest. You gain a +2 item bonus to [Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=34) and [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=36) skill checks.

**Activate—Effortless Mastery** <actions string="Free Action" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561)) **Frequency** once per day;  **Requirements** You succeed at an Acrobatics or Athletics skill check; **Effect** You critically succeed instead.

**Activate—Reserves of Inner Strength** <actions string="Free Action" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You gain 1 Focus Point, which you can spend only to cast a qi spell. If you don't spend this Focus Point by the end of this turn, it's lost.

<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 8"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Satchel of Numberless Seeds](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3944)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Battlecry!](/Sources.aspx?ID=268) pg. 146

**Price** 480 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** 1
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This satchel is made of finely worked leather and stitched with golden thread. A complex pattern of trees, leaves, and vines covers its surface. The satchel always contains a bulk of seeds, and drawing one from the bag results in a random tree or crop plant seed.

**Activate—Seed of Saftey** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645), [primal](/Traits.aspx?ID=676)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You draw a seed and cast it into a space within 30 feet. The satchel casts [_protector tree_](/Spells.aspx?ID=2015) as a 2nd-rank spell.

**Activate—Seed of Sustenance** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([healing](/Traits.aspx?ID=623), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645), [primal](/Traits.aspx?ID=676)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You draw a seed and cast it into a space within 30 feet. A small tree sprouts within 10 minutes, producing 5 fruits. A creature who eats the fruit with an [Interact](/Actions.aspx?ID=2297) action regains 1d6+2 Hit Points and receives as much nourishment as one meal for a typical human. After an hour, the tree and all its fruits wither away.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 128 **Usage** affixed to armor or a weapon --- This jagged, bony growth narrows to a sharp, pointed tip. Deep groves from some former battle scar its surface. The bearer of a _saurian spike_ often feels a sudden surge in power and confidence. The spell attack modifier of any spell cast by activating this item is +15.
  • **Armor** You gain [imprecise](/Rules.aspx?ID=2407) [scent](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=74) with a range of 30 feet.
  • **Weapon** ([auditory](/Traits.aspx?ID=541), [emotion](/Traits.aspx?ID=590), [fear](/Traits.aspx?ID=598), [visual](/Traits.aspx?ID=727)) When you cast a [polymorph](/Traits.aspx?ID=670) spell by activating the spike, your battle form is exceptionally fearsome. Each enemy in a 30-foot [emanation](/Rules.aspx?ID=2387) must succeed at a DC 27 Will saving throw or become [frightened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=76) 1 (frightened 2 on a critical failure).
**Activate** Cast a Spell; **Effect** You cast [_gouging claw_](/Spells.aspx?ID=920). Saurian Spike **Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 128 **Price** 700 gp --- **Activate** Cast a Spell; **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** You cast [_dinosaur form_](/Spells.aspx?ID=72). Saurian Spike (Greater) **Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 128 **Price** 1,400 gp --- The range of the scent and fear emanation are both 60 feet, and their save DC is 28. The spell attack modifier is +18. **Activate** Cast a Spell; **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** You cast 5th-rank _dinosaur form_. Saurian Spike (Major) **Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 128 **Price** 6,500 gp --- The range of the scent and fear emanation are both 60 feet. The scent is [precise](/Rules.aspx?ID=2406) instead of imprecise, and creatures that fail their saves are frightened 2 (frightened 3 on a critical failure) with a DC 34 save. The spell attack modifier is +24. **Activate** Cast a Spell; **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** You cast 7th-rank _dinosaur form_.

**Requirement** You're an expert in Reflex
</row>

This pyramid-shaped spike is attached to an armor’s chest piece. When you activate the spike, it shoots a strand of force to help you gain purchase. If you roll a success on the triggering attempt, you get a critical success instead (if you roll a critical failure, you get a failure instead).

</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=683" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=644" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [High Seas](/Sources.aspx?ID=351) pg. 64

_[**PFS Note**](/pathfinder-society) No duration on effects._

**Price** 6,000 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 2 hands

**Bulk** 1
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Base Weapon** [Kusarigama](/Weapons.aspx?ID=291)
</row>

**Access** You're a member of the Red Mantis Assassins

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

The serrated blade and chain of this _[+2](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2830) [greater striking](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2829) [keen](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2843) [wounding](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2854) kusarigama_ shine blood red. A crimson haze wafts from the blade. 

**Activate—Ensnaring Disarm** <actions string="Reaction" /> ;   **Trigger** An enemy within reach misses you with a melee weapon [Strike](/Actions.aspx?ID=1167);  **Effect** You attempt to [Disarm](/Actions.aspx?ID=2383) the triggering creature. You can do so even if you don’t have a hand free. 

**Activate—Bloodmist Whirl** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) **Frequency** once per hour;   **Effect** You whirl the chain of the _sawtooth reaper_, creating a crimson fog that conceals you for 1 round or until you Strike. The next Strike you make treats the target as [off-guard](/Conditions.aspx?ID=58), and when you use Ensnaring Disarm you can also Strike the same target as a free action.

</column>

Prized by naari geniekin who prefer to fight with their fists, _scalding gauntlets_ are a pair of _+2 [striking](/Equipment.aspx?ID=280) [spiked gauntlets](/Weapons.aspx?ID=11)_. The intricate golden gauntlets are engraved with [Pyric](/Languages.aspx?ID=110) writing praising the glories of the Dominion of Flame and embellished with shimmering black and red gemstones. A creature you [grab](/Conditions.aspx?ID=20) or [restrain](/Conditions.aspx?ID=33) while wearing the gauntlets must succeed at a DC 26 Fortitude save or take 2d6 [persistent fire damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29) and be [sickened 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=34) from the pain; it's temporarily immune to being sickened by _scalding gauntlets_ for 1 hour.

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 180 **Usage** held in 1 hand **Bulk** L --- Carved from a scale of the [kaiju](/Traits.aspx?ID=383) Igroon, this jagged shield refracts light around it in a shimmering haze. A _scale of Igroon_ (Hardness 20, HP 160, BT 80) recovers 4 Hit Points at the start of its wielder's turn. When you [Raise a Shield](/Actions.aspx?ID=98), you can use the [Shield Block](/Feats.aspx?ID=839) reaction with the scale of Igroon to block an attack or effect that deals acid, cold, electricity, fire, force, or sonic damage as well as physical damage. **Activate** ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) **Requirements** You're in an area of [bright](/Rules.aspx?ID=407) or [dim light](/Rules.aspx?ID=408); **Effect** You angle the shield to refract light. Until the start of your next turn, you gain a +4 item bonus to [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) checks to [Hide](/Actions.aspx?ID=62) and [Sneak](/Actions.aspx?ID=63) and can do so while [observed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=27). This bonus ends if you Activate another ability or use the Shield Block reaction. **Activate** ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) **Requirements** You're in an area of bright light; **Effect** You angle the shield at a target within 60 feet, reflecting light into its eyes. It must attempt a DC 42 Fortitude save. **Critical Success** The target is unaffected.
**Success** The target is [blinded](/Conditions.aspx?ID=1) until its next turn begins.
**Failure** The target is blinded for 1 minute.
**Critical Failure** The target is blinded for 2d4 hours. **Activate** ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) **Trigger** You use Shield Block and prevent yourself from taking energy damage from a line, ray, or a direct attack, including a [_force barrage_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1536) spell; **Effect** You reflect the energy along a trajectory you choose. The effect travels only up to its remaining range, using its original parameters if it strikes other targets. **Destruction** If a deity, kaiju, spawn of a deity, titan, or being of similar power stomps on a _scale of Igroon_ while in absolute darkness, the shield is destroyed permanently.

<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 17"
    pfs="Limited"
>
[Scapular of Shields](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2530)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Stolen Fate</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=137" />
<trait label="Abjuration" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=2" />
<trait label="Apex" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=10" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #192: Worst of All Possible Worlds](/Sources.aspx?ID=203) pg. 70

**Price** 15,000 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn garment

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This fine scapular features the image of an ornate shield. While wearing the cloak, you feel protected and capable of withstanding even the deadliest blows. Each time you're critically hit while wearing the scapular, attempt a DC 17 flat check. On a success, it becomes a normal hit. When you invest the scapular, you either increase your Constitution score by 2 or increase it to 18, whichever would give you a higher score.

**Activate** <actions string="Reaction" /> envision;  **Frequency** once per minute; **Trigger** You're critically hit with an attack;  **Effect** The shield on your scapular glows with light, helping reduce the effectiveness of the attack. You take normal damage from the triggering attack as if the attack were a normal hit instead. Other effects that trigger with critical hits such as the [deadly](/Traits.aspx?ID=174) weapon trait, additional conditions, and so on still occur.

**Activate** <actions string="Reaction" /> envision;  **Frequency** once per day; **Trigger** You would take damage from an attack;  **Effect** The shield on your scapular animates and intercedes on the attack. You gain 20 resistance to all damage against the triggering damage.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

---

The _scarlet queen_ is a _+2 [striking](/Equipment.aspx?ID=280) [flaming](/Equipment.aspx?ID=295) [hammer gun](/Weapons.aspx?ID=219)_. Due to the awkward and complex nature of combination weapons, it's by far the least popular of Ornmarr's designs, but those who have mastered it consider it his finest creation to date. The glistening red steel always feels warm to the touch and sheds [dim light](/Rules.aspx?ID=408) in a 15-foot radius. Any non-magical object of light Bulk destroyed by the _scarlet queen_ is reduced completely to ash.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> envision, Interact;  **Frequency** once per day;  **Requirements** The _scarlet queen_ is in its firearm form; **Effect** You fire a blast of magically disruptive energy at an unattended magical object. You cast 5th-level [_dispel magic_](/Spells.aspx?ID=78) with a [counteract](/Rules.aspx?ID=371) bonus of +21 against the object.

May contain spoilers from Curtain Call **Source** [Pathfinder #204: Stage Fright](/Sources.aspx?ID=245) pg. 79 **Price** 3,000 gp **Usage** worn armor **Bulk** L **Base Armor** [Padded Armor](/Armor.aspx?ID=40) --- This suit of [padded armor](/Armor.aspx?ID=40) consists of a beautifully woven pleated tunic adorned with a gold pattern and narrow bands of white fur trim on a deep blue background with matching pants, all of which are meant to signal wealth and status. This _[+2](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2785) [resilient](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2786) [raiment](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2791) padded armor_ was custom designed for Alessandro Domenesso, an actor as well known for their astounding costume changes as for their roguish off-stage activities. Even without utilizing the magic of this armor, it’s elegant enough that it could easily be mistaken as fine clothing. **Activate—Look At Me!** ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [illusion](/Traits.aspx?ID=629), [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=647), [visual](/Traits.aspx?ID=727)) **Frequency** once per hour; **Effect** You make yourself visible and apparent to a creature you can see that’s within 30 feet. The _scene stealer’s tunic_ transforms into something incredibly gaudy, distracting, or otherwise compelling to the target creature, who must attempt a DC 30 Will save. **Critical Success** The target is unaffected.
**Success** The target is distracted by you and keeps looking your way. They take a –1 status penalty to Perception checks against everything but you, a –1 status penalty to all saving throws against your visual effects, and gain a +2 status bonus to all saving throws against visual effects created by anyone else; these penalties and bonus last for 1 minute.
**Failure** As success, but the target is also [off‑guard](/Conditions.aspx?ID=58) to everyone other than you as long as you remain visible.
**Critical Failure** As failure, but the target also becomes [slowed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=92) 1 as they spend extra time on their turn admiring, glowering, or otherwise being distracted by you.

<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 6"
    pfs="Limited"
>
[Schematic Scanner](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3800)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Shades of Blood</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #215: To Blot Out the Sun](/Sources.aspx?ID=259) pg. 80

**Price** 230 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held

**Bulk** 1
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

A _schematic scanner_ is a complex brass device featuring multiple mounted lenses, clamps, and apertures. A _schematic scanner_ can hold the formulas for items as if it were a formula book with unlimited capacity. You can add a formula to the _schematic scanner_ using the Store Schematics activation. A _schematic scanner_ grants you a +2 item bonus to [Crafting](/Skills.aspx?ID=37) checks to craft an item whose formula is stored in the _schematic scanner_. 

**Activate—Store Schematics** <actions string="Three Actions" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645))    **Effect** You place the written formula for an item into the _schematic scanner_ and view it through the mounted lenses, magically storing a copy of the formula inside the _schematic scanner_.

**Activate—Reverse Engineer Schematics** <actions string="" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645))    **Effect** You place an item in front of the _schematic scanner_, then view the item through the mounted lenses, magically learning the formula for the targeted item, without disassembling or causing harm to the item, and storing the formula in the _schematic scanner_. Reverse engineering a formula in this way takes 10 minutes and doesn’t cost any gold.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

[Scholar's Drop](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1929)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Alchemical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=6" />
<trait label="Consumable" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=36" />
<trait label="Lozenge" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=484" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 50

**Price** 40 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

University students in Katapesh first used the scholar's drop to gain an edge over their academic rivals, but the candy has since spread across Golarion. The flavor of this hard, sugar-coated candy is highly refreshing and based on lemon and green tea. For 1 hour, you gain a +1 item bonus to saving throws against effects that could render you [fatigued](/Conditions.aspx?ID=15).

 **Secondary Effect** <actions string="Two Actions" /> **Requirements** You're fatigued; **Effect** Ignore the effects of the fatigued condition for 10 minutes. The drop's other effects end for you, and when the 10 minutes are up, you're temporarily immune to scholar's drops for 1 hour. If you use this effect three times in a single day, you become temporarily immune to scholar's drops entirely until you get a full night's rest.

</column>

    pfs="Standard"
>
[Scizore of the Crab](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1887)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 36

**Price** 150 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn on 1 hand

**Bulk** 1
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Base Weapon** [Scizore](/Weapons.aspx?ID=303)
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

A _scizore of the crab_ is a _+1 [scizore](/Weapons.aspx?ID=303)_ that has the [grapple](/Traits.aspx?ID=184) trait in addition to its normal weapon traits.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645))   **Requirements** Your last action was a successful Strike with this weapon, or you have a creature [grabbed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=20) with this weapon; **Effect** The target is grabbed until the end of your next turn. A grabbed creature can use the [Escape](/Actions.aspx?ID=79) action to get out of the Grab, and the Grab ends for a grabbed creature if you move away from it. This functions as the [Grab](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=18) creature ability.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) **Frequency** once per round;  **Requirements** You have a creature [grabbed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=20) with this weapon; **Effect** The crab claw animates and pinches open and shut, dealing slashing damage equal to the _scizore of the crab's_ number of damage dice.

**Craft Requirements** The initial raw materials must include a claw from a [giant crab](/Monsters.aspx?ID=588) or similar creature.

</column>

<title

    right="Item 10"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Scope of Limning](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1215)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Guns & Gears (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=98) pg. 182

_[**PFS Note**](/pathfinder-society) Characters with access to firearms gain access to accessories that can be used with those weapons._

**Price** 900 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** attached to firearm (scope)

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

The dwarven gunsmiths of Dongun Hold originally created these scopes to help them clear out vermin in underground areas. This scope captures the sound that echoes off a creature hit by the firearm and transforms it into light, illuminating the target for all to see.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([auditory](/Traits.aspx?ID=541), [light](/Traits.aspx?ID=640), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645))    **Effect** If your next Strike from the weapon to which the scope is attached hits a creature, the sound of the impact transforms into light, causing the creature to glow until the end of your next turn. A visible creature can't be [concealed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=4) while they glow. If a creature is [invisible](/Conditions.aspx?ID=26), they're concealed while glowing, rather than being [undetected](/Conditions.aspx?ID=39). Because the effect requires a solid impact, [incorporeal](/Traits.aspx?ID=222) creatures are unaffected unless the bullet can deal force damage or has the effects of the [_ghost touch_](/Equipment.aspx?ID=297) property rune.

</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Guns & Gears (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=98) pg. 182

_[**PFS Note**](/pathfinder-society) Characters with access to firearms gain access to accessories that can be used with those weapons. Replace the word "transmutation" in the scope of truth with the word "polymorph."_

**Price** 3,000 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** attached to firearm or crossbow (scope)

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

The _scope of truth_ is a bit bigger than most to accommodate larger lenses, which have been magically prepared with tiny shards from crystal balls to reveal the truth. The scope grants you a +2 item bonus to Perception checks made to [Seek](/Actions.aspx?ID=84) in areas you can see through the scope.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** For the next 10 minutes, you can see things through the scope as they actually are. The GM rolls a [secret](/Traits.aspx?ID=142) [counteract](/Rules.aspx?ID=371) check with a +20 counteract modifier and a counteract level of 7 against any [illusion](/Traits.aspx?ID=92) or [transmutation](/Traits.aspx?ID=157) in the area, but only for the purpose of determining whether you see through it, not to end the spell or effect. For instance, if the check succeeds against a [polymorph](/Traits.aspx?ID=127) spell, you can see the creature's true form, but you don't end the spell.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

This _[+2 greater striking](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2861) [ flintlock musket](/Weapons.aspx?ID=191)_ is an innovation of the Platinum Wing, and possession of one by a civilian is a high crime in Andoran. The gun’s secret is the chip of a warshard used as the hammer in the striking mechanism.

**Activate—Transcendent Shot** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645))   **Requirements** The _screaming pinion_ is unloaded; **Effect** You call on the power of the warshard to load the _screaming pinion_ with a bullet made of divine fury. The next attack from the gun deals [spirit](/Traits.aspx?ID=737) damage, rather than its typical type, and on a critical hit, the target is subject to the weapon’s [critical specialization](/Rules.aspx?ID=2203) effect. If the gun isn’t fired before the end of your next turn, the bullet disappears, and the gun becomes unloaded.

**Activate—Eagle’s Cry** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645), [sonic](/Traits.aspx?ID=697)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** The musket unleashes a piercing sound wave in a 70-foot [line](/Rules.aspx?ID=2388). Each creature in the area takes 8d10 [sonic](/Traits.aspx?ID=697) damage with a DC 30 basic Fortitude save. A creature that critically fails its save is also [deafened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=66). If the _screaming pinion_ has a [_+3 potency_ rune](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2830), the DC increases to 35, and the damage increases to 10d10.

---

These belts are specially designed to allow for writing along the inside surface. You can scribe a spell to a scroll belt, [Crafting](/Actions.aspx?ID=43) the [scroll](/Equipment.aspx?Category=15&Subcategory=52) as normal. A scroll belt can only hold a single spell, and you must Cast the Spell before you can scribe another spell to the belt. You can't Cast a Spell from the belt while wearing it; you must remove the belt with an Interact action. A scroll belt acts as a mundane belt, but when a spell is scribed on it, any creature can immediately discern that an unattended belt holds magic. If you're wearing the belt, a creature can notice the belt holds a spell with a successful Perception check against your [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) DC.

The four different types of _scroll cases of simplicity_ often bear adornments appropriate to their magical tradition, such as angelic wings or otherworldly lettering. On the inside, intricate runic diagrams spiral out to surround the scroll stored within. A scroll placed within the case can be converted into energy to cast consistently useful spells depending on its type. You must be able to cast spells of a given tradition to use a _scroll case of simplicity_ of a corresponding type.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> Interact;    **Requirements** The scroll case contains a single scroll of a 1st-level spell; **Effect** You transfer the scroll’s energy into the scroll case, consuming the scroll, and you can immediately begin casting one of the scroll case’s spells. If you use any action other than to Cast a Spell from the scroll case after activating the _scroll case of simplicity_, the scroll and its energy are lost.

<traits>

<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />

</row>

**Access** A character who is Magaambyan of at least attendant rank has access to this option.

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

A band of pliant wood encircles the head of this slender mahogany staff. The Magaambya created the first _scrollstaves_ millennia ago, and even the few _scrollstaves_ found beyond the organization often incorporate Magaambyan iconography as an homage to their source.

 A _scrollstaff_ serves as a weapon just like an ordinary [staff](/Weapons.aspx?ID=12) and can be improved via runes like any other staff. In addition, if you are capable of creating magical scrolls, you can inscribe a single scroll onto the staff’s head for the same cost as normal for [Crafting](/Actions.aspx?ID=43) the scroll. If necessary, you can embed a required material focus into the staff as part of the same Craft activity. As long as you are holding the staff, you can cast the spell from the staff’s head. Casting the written spell works just like casting from a scroll, but you can perform the necessary material component with the staff, even if you don’t have a free hand. Once you cast the inscribed spell, any material focus remains embedded in the staff until removed as an Interact action.

 The staff can hold only a single scroll at a time. If you inscribe a new scroll before casting the previous spell, you replace the existing spell and remove any previous material focus as part of the Craft activity to write the new scroll.

</column>

This braided sea kelp rope writhes slowly when submerged in water. 

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645))   **Requirements** The target is in water; **Effect** The _sea retrieval line_ uncoils and stretches through the water toward a target of your choice—an unattended, stationary object or willing creature of 10 Bulk or less. The end of the rope moves 20 feet when you Activate it and at the start of each of your turns, to a maximum length of 120 feet, until it reaches the target or runs out of length. Once it reaches the target, the vine pulls the unattended object or willing creature toward you, or pulls you toward the stationary object, at the same rate.

Vigilant Seal members use these containers when transporting samples and relics. The containers are soundproof, airtight, and studded with lead sheets, mistletoe, and other materials that block magical auras. Up to 1 Bulk of objects can be placed inside a _sealing chest_; the magic auras and curses of any objects placed within the chest cannot extend beyond the box unless they are of a greater level than the chest. [Artifacts](/Traits.aspx?ID=253) and similarly powerful items are unaffected regardless of level. Many cursed items prevent their bearer from removing them, but a successful [_remove curse_](/Spells.aspx?ID=250) gives enough time to stash the item in the chest.

fields.text: Item 1+ Searing Suture May contain spoilers from Outlaws of Alkenstar Uncommon Alchemical Consumable Fire Source Pathfinder #178: Punks in a Powderkeg pg. 77 Usage held in 1 hand Bulk L Activate Single Action Interact Activating this black powder–infused alchemical bandage cauterizes wounds. You can apply a searing suture to yourself or an adjacent willing creature as you activate it. The target creature takes 1d6 fire damage and can immediately attempt a flat check to remove the persistent bleed damage—the DC of this flat check depends on the type of searing suture applied. When applied against a bleed effect that is lower level than the searing suture, the flat check is automatically successful. Item 1 Searing Suture (Lesser) Source Pathfinder #178: Punks in a Powderkeg pg. 77 Price 3 gp Bulk L The flat check DC is 15. Item 9 Searing Suture (greater) Source Pathfinder #178: Punks in a Powderkeg pg. 77 Price 120 gp Bulk L The flat check DC is 5.

<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 3+"

>
[Secret-Keeper's Mask](/Equipment.aspx?ID=914)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=137" />
<trait label="Divination" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=47" />
<trait label="Enchantment" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=61" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [GM's Toolkit: Secret Keeper's Mask](/Sources.aspx?ID=67)

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Each of these full-face masks is made of stitched materials—often including humanoid skin—and has a single, bulbous eye. While wearing the mask, you gain a +1 item bonus to [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=5) checks to [Lie](/Actions.aspx?ID=47) and the mask doesn't impair your vision. The mask can also be activated, with an ability based on its type.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

<title
level="2"
right="Item 3"
pfs=""
>
Secret-Keeper's Mask (Blackfingers)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [GM's Toolkit: Secret Keeper's Mask](/Sources.aspx?ID=67)

**Price** 60 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

This featureless mask is made of thin, papery skin. Its single eye is a fragile bubble of venom-filled glass.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> Interact;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You twist the mask's eye and peer at an object. You know whether the object is poison or has been poisoned, but you don't learn the number or type of poisons present in the object.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 5"
pfs=""
>
Secret-Keeper's Mask (Gray Master)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [GM's Toolkit: Secret Keeper's Mask](/Sources.aspx?ID=67)

**Price** 150 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

This monochrome mask is made of tattered rags of gray and black cloth and bleached fragments of skin.

**Activate** <actions string="Reaction" /> Interact;  **Frequency** once per day; **Trigger** You succeed on a [Thievery](/Skills.aspx?ID=17) check to [Steal](/Actions.aspx?ID=68) an item of negligible Bulk;  **Effect** You create an illusory duplicate of the item you just stole. This duplicate has the appropriate appearance and weight, but it doesn't make sounds or generate smells. The illusion vanishes after 10 minutes, or earlier if anyone examines or manipulates the illusory duplicate (such as to try to use it).

<title
level="2"
right="Item 6"
pfs=""
>
Secret-Keeper's Mask (Father Skinsaw)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [GM's Toolkit: Secret Keeper's Mask](/Sources.aspx?ID=67)

**Price** 250 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

This mask is a patchwork of tanned skins, each with a distinctive scar. It is contorted into a caricature of a face with a leering eye.

**Activate** <actions string="Reaction" /> Interact;  **Frequency** once per day; **Trigger** You deal [persistent bleed damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29) to a creature;  **Effect** The bleeding wound you cause is particularly mutilating. The DC of flat checks to recover from the persistent bleed damage is increased by 2, and the target creature has a –2 status penalty to [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=5), [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=6), and [Performance](/Skills.aspx?ID=12) checks while it is bleeding and for 1 minute after it ceases bleeding.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 3"
pfs=""
>
Secret-Keeper's Mask (Reaper of Reputation)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [GM's Toolkit: Secret Keeper's Mask](/Sources.aspx?ID=67)

**Price** 60 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

This mask is made of gray and black tiles sewn together. It has a messy, inky spiral over the mouth.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> Interact (auditory, linguistic);  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You touch the mask's spiral and identify a target creature within 30 feet. For the next 10 minutes, any normal speech you utter can, at your discretion, be inaudible to all creatures except the target creature, who can hear you clearly regardless of ambient sound so long as it is within 1 mile. This ability doesn't silence magical words, such as the verbal component of spellcasting or commands to activate magic items.

You gain a +1 item bonus to [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=40) checks. **Activate—Authoritative Command** ([auditory](/Traits.aspx?ID=541), [concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [incapacitation](/Traits.aspx?ID=631), [linguistic](/Traits.aspx?ID=642), [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=647)) **Effect** You shout at a foe within 60 feet, compelling them to stand in place and drop everything they’re holding. The target attempts a DC 23 Will save with the following results. **Critical Success** The target is unaffected.
**Success** The target is [slowed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=92) 1 as it does one of the following at the beginning of its next turn: stand in place or release what it’s holding.
**Failure** The target is slowed 2 as it stands in place and releases what it’s holding at the beginning of its next turn.
**Critical Failure** The target is slowed 3 as it spends its next turn to stand in place, release what it’s holding, and place its hands in the air. **Special** A creature wearing an invested security badge within En-Gokal gains additional benefits, as noted in the [adventure text](/Sources.aspx?ID=258).

>
[Self-Emptying Pocket](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1656)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=137" />
<trait label="Contract" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=329" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Dark Archive](/Sources.aspx?ID=129) pg. 165

<row gap="medium">

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

You never perform to an empty crowd after promising any profits to a phantom in a playhouse, sealed by holes that appear in your pockets. By meeting with the attendees at your events, you can use [Performance](/Skills.aspx?ID=12) instead of [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=6) to [Gather Information](/Actions.aspx?ID=49). When you would use Performance to [Earn Income](/Actions.aspx?ID=23), you don't earn any gold pieces, as the money disappears before you can even count it.

 The entity that holds your _bargained contract_ can influence your reception any time you perform for a crowd or Activate the pocket. If they influence your performance favorably, you gain a +2 item bonus to your Performance check. If they influence your performance unfavorably, you gain a -2 item penalty to your Performance check. If you've failed to earn the entity money in quite a while, it typically influences your performance unfavorably.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> command, envision;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You exercise all of your charm on a creature, turning a chance meeting into an impromptu performance that commands attention. Attempt a single Performance check against the Perception DC of the creature. On a success, the creature is affected as though by a successful Deception check to [Create a Diversion](/Actions.aspx?ID=45). The entity that holds your contract can influence this performance as well.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Alchemical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=6" />
<trait label="Consumable" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=36" />
<trait label="Fire" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=72" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Dark Archive](/Sources.aspx?ID=129) pg. 83

**Price** 3 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Hands** 1

**Usage** held in 1 hand

</row>

**Access** Member of a secret society

<row gap="medium">
<row gap="tiny"><row>**Activate**</row><actions string="Single Action" /><row>Interact</row></row>

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This paper is crafted with an unusual formula, causing it to catch fire and self-immolate 5 minutes after being exposed to the air. The item activates automatically when the envelope is opened, which typically takes an Interact action. Anyone holding the note when it catches fire takes 1 fire damage. Often, these notes are given as practical jokes or threats, but secret societies find them quite useful when sharing information about upcoming meetings or any other relevant news. These letters must be written in haste and require the use of their accompanying envelopes, which prevent air from interacting with the paper until the envelope's seal is broken.

</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

<row gap="medium">

</row>

---

A suit of armor etched with this rune can create a bolstering magical layer that closes off to protect the wearer against dangerous environments. When you would take environmental damage, or when you enter an environment where you can’t safely breathe, your _self-sealing_ armor seals itself shut. It holds 1 minute’s worth of air and grants you [resistance](/Rules.aspx?ID=2318) 10 to environmental damage while sealed. You or another creature can take an [Interact](/Actions.aspx?ID=2297) action to unseal it at any time. Once unsealed, the armor can’t seal itself again for 1 hour.

---

Sometimes, an enemy’s dangerous special ability makes relatively standard sensory capabilities a liability. From an [ofalth](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3117) emitting its stench to a [banshee](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2845) wailing, plenty of creatures use their prey’s senses against them. A sensedulling hood is a wide, single-use mask designed to be pulled from an airtight package and slipped over the head. The mask grants you an item bonus to saving throws against [auditory](/Traits.aspx?ID=541), [olfactory](/Traits.aspx?ID=664), and [visual](/Traits.aspx?ID=727) effects for a time, according to the mask’s type. Since it dulls your senses without depriving you of them, the mask also imposes a –1 penalty to rolls and checks using [Perception](/Rules.aspx?ID=3303) for the same duration.

<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 11"
    pfs="Limited"
>
[Sensei's Parasol](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3165)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Season of Ghosts</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=683" />
<trait label="Abjuration" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=2" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=644" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #199: To Bloom Below the Web](/Sources.aspx?ID=225) pg. 75

**Price** 1,400 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** 1
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Base Weapon** [Bo Staff](/Weapons.aspx?ID=17)
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

A master once said to his pupil that, in the hands of a skilled practitioner, even a parasol can become a deadly weapon. Returning the next day, the pupil excitedly turned over a parasol forged out of metal slats, explaining that it lowered the amount of skill one would need to exert deadly force. The master sighed, seeing that his pupil had failed to see the point, but accepted the gift nonetheless. Ingenuity was, after all, a virtue.

 Since then, additional _sensei's parasols_ have been crafted, and they're very sought after. This weapon functions as a _+2 striking bo staff._ 

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> Interact;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You cause the metal slats of the parasol to open up, transforming it into a _[moderate sturdy shield](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2828)_ (Hardness 13, HP 104 [BT 51]). You can sustain this activation for up to 10 minutes, after which the sensei's parasol reverts back to bo-staff form. If it's broken as a shield, it reverts to its undamaged bo-staff form. If it's destroyed as a shield, it reverts to bo-staff form and becomes broken. 

**Activate** <actions string="Reaction" /> envision;  **Frequency** once per day; **Trigger** A creature misses you with a melee Strike; **Requirements** The _sensei's parasol_ is in bo-staff form and isn't broken; **Effect** You redirect the missed Strike to target a creature or object within the triggering creature's reach. The triggering creature rolls a new Strike against the new target to determine the results of the redirected attack.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

>
[Sentry Fulu](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2042)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Consumable" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=36" />
<trait label="Fulu" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=378" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 78

**Price** 15 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** affixed to the ground

</row>

<row gap="medium">
<row gap="tiny"><row>**Activate**</row><actions string="Three Actions" /><row>([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645))</row></row>

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

A _sentry fulu_ depicts an armed guard. When you activate the fulu, it takes the shape of a Tiny humanoid guard made of paper and keeps watch over an area in a 20-foot burst. The guard has a Perception DC of 20, along with [precise](/Rules.aspx?ID=411) visual senses and [imprecise](/Rules.aspx?ID=412) hearing and vibrational sense to detect creatures moving in its area, including through the air. You dictate whether the guard remains still in its area or patrols it; if the latter, you also determine the path the guard takes, at a Speed of 25 feet. You also determine a password others must give the guard to bypass it. If a creature enters the area without giving the password, the sentry creates either an audible or mental alarm. An audible alarm has the sound and volume of a human shouting, as well as the [auditory](/Traits.aspx?ID=16) trait, allowing each creature that can hear it to attempt a DC 15 Perception check to wake up if they're asleep. The mental alert reaches you if you're within 60 feet of the active guard (see below). The guard remains active for 8 hours, and then the fulu is consumed.

 If you have more than one _sentry fulu_, you can set up several that function as a unit, provided their areas touch or overlap. When one sounds its alarm, the alarm passes through all of them, so you must be within range of only one to hear it or receive the mental alert. Creatures that give the correct password to one _sentry fulu_ in a unit need not give that password again to the others. The destruction of one fulu-created guard in a unit sets off the alarm in others in connected areas.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

<row gap="medium">
<row gap="tiny"><row>**Activate**</row><actions string="Single Action" /><row>([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104))</row></row>

 

 

 
</row>

---

You gain inner serenity, but you find violence off-putting.

**Benefit** You gain an item bonus to Will saves and Perception, [Medicine](/Skills.aspx?ID=42), [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=43), [Religion](/Skills.aspx?ID=46), and [Survival](/Skills.aspx?ID=49) checks. This bonus improves when you attempt Will saves against mental effects. 

**Drawback** You take a –1 penalty to attack rolls and save DCs of offensive spells, and a –1 penalty per damage die to all weapon, unarmed attack, and spell damage.

</column>

>
[Serithtial](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3123)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Unique" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=723" />
<trait label="No Alignment" url="/Rules.aspx?ID=95" />
<trait label="Artifact" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=537" />
<trait label="Divine" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=579" />
<trait label="Intelligent" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=636" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 302

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** 1
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Base Weapon** [Bastard Sword](/Weapons.aspx?ID=370)
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Perception** +28; normal vision and hearing within 60 feet

**Communication** empathy (partner only)

**Skills** [Iomedae Lore](/Skills.aspx?ID=8) +29, [Religion](/Skills.aspx?ID=13) +26, Zon-Kuthon Lore +29

**Int** +2, **Wis** +1, **Cha** +2

**Will** +30 

</column>

---        

The legendary blade _Serithtial_ is said to have been forged by [Iomedae](/Deities.aspx?ID=9), goddess of honor, justice, and valor. She is an intelligent _+4 [major striking](/Equipment.aspx?ID=280) [holy](/Equipment.aspx?ID=299) [bastard sword](/Weapons.aspx?ID=15)_. Although the sword is made of steel, Serithtial is also treated as [cold iron](/Equipment.aspx?ID=375) and [silver](/Equipment.aspx?ID=379), allowing her to deal more damage to certain supernatural creatures. She glows as bright as a [torch](/Equipment.aspx?ID=60), but you or _Serithtial_ can suppress or resume this glow as a single action, which has the [concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32) trait. In addition, Strikes with _Serithtial_ deal an additional 2d6 damage against creatures that are worshippers of [Zon-Kuthon](/Deities.aspx?ID=20). While wielding _Serithtial_, against effects created by followers of Zon-Kuthon you gain the benefit of [_unfettered movement_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1732), a +4 status bonus to saves against [death](/Traits.aspx?ID=40) and [void](/Traits.aspx?ID=510) effects, void resistance 10, and suppress the [doomed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=9) condition.

 _Serithtial_ was forged as a bastard sword, and she reverts to this shape when no one wields her, but she can also detect what sort of blade her current wielder prefers and transform into it (choosing from [dagger](/Weapons.aspx?ID=3), [shortsword](/Weapons.aspx?ID=43), [longsword](/Weapons.aspx?ID=31), [scimitar](/Weapons.aspx?ID=38), [falchion](/Weapons.aspx?ID=18), [greatsword](/Weapons.aspx?ID=24), [rapier](/Weapons.aspx?ID=36), or bastard sword) using an action, which she does when first held. The wielder can empathically tell Serithtial to transform at any time by using a single action, which has the [concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32) trait, after which Serithtial uses an action to transform.

 Serithtial is willing to work with almost any partner as long as they are dedicated to defeating the great wyrm Kazavon and the forces of Zon-Kuthon. If you ignore those threats and pursue your own agenda instead, before long _Serithtial_ attempts to seize control of your body (DC 45 Will save to resist her control), though she typically remains in control for only long enough to find a more worthy partner. You can attempt a new Will save each day to retake control of your body.

**Activate—Grace of the Inheritor** <actions string="" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32)) **Frequency** once per hour;   **Effect** _Serithtial_ spends the appropriate number of actions and casts a 9th-rank [_heal_](/Spells.aspx?ID=148) or [_ring of truth_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1656) spell (DC 45 for either of the two spells).

**Destruction** If Kazavon or a great wyrm shadow dragon who is a worshipper of Zon-Kuthon uses its dragon breath on _Serithtial_ while she is unattended, the sword melts into a pool of mundane iron.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

This glistening oil has a green hue and tiny snake scales floating within. If you slather _serpent oil_ on a Tiny object that is snakelike in shape, from a stick to a scarf, the object transforms into a [viper](/Monsters.aspx?ID=379), keeping some of the same colors and patterns of the original item. If placed on other objects, the oil fails and is wasted. This false snake has the [minion](/Traits.aspx?ID=109) trait. It remains in snake form for 1 minute before returning to its object state. If slain, the item returns to its original form, unharmed.

If slain, the item returns to its original form, unharmed.

On your next hit with the weapon this turn that deals slashing damage, the _serrating_ rune adds an additional 1d12 damage instead of the additional 1d4 damage, and then the shards return to their usual speed.

On your next hit with the weapon this turn that deals slashing damage, the serrating rune adds an additional 1d12 damage instead of the additional 1d4 damage, and then the shards return to their usual speed.

>
[Serum of Sex Shift](/Equipment.aspx?ID=198)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Consumable" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=36" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Potion" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=130" />
<trait label="Transmutation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=157" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 564

**Price** 60 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">
<row gap="tiny"><row>**Activate**</row><actions string="Single Action" /><row>Interact</row></row>

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Upon drinking this potion, your biology instantly transforms to take on a set of sexual characteristics of your choice, changing your appearance and physiology accordingly. You have mild control over the details of this change, but you retain a strong “family resemblance” to your former appearance.

 The magic functions instantaneously and can’t be counteracted. Your new anatomy is as healthy and functional as your previous body’s, potentially allowing you to procreate (depending on your ancestry’s biology). Drinking a subsequent _serum of sex shift_ allows you to either revert back to your original form or adopt other sexual characteristics, as you choose. The elixir has no effect if you are pregnant or from an ancestry with no sexual differentiation. Most ancestries have a wide spectrum of sexual differentiation, some common, others more rare.

</column>

---

The type of animal tongue used in this tomato-based stew shifts from region to region, but it's always cooked with spirit of wine and seasoned with [refined pesh](/Equipment.aspx?ID=626). Eating this restaurant-staff favorite empowers you to speak and understand a single language for 1 hour. This must be a language the stew's cook could speak and understand, chosen at the time of the stew's creation. It also helps your words land smoothly, granting you a +2 item bonus to [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=6) checks made in that language for the same duration. It doesn't allow you to read the newly acquired language in its written form.

[Sextant of the Night](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2196)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 116

**Price** 95 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** 1
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This finely wrought sextant is made from silver with several onyx mirrors and shades made from thin sets of crystal glass. A [fine spyglass](/Equipment.aspx?ID=54) made of silver is affixed to the frame; removing the spyglass destroys the sextant. By all appearances, the sextant shouldn't function, as the shades and mirrors are swapped, but when you look through the spyglass, you see a night sky during the day and the sun during the night, as if day and night were inverted.

 When you use the sextant, you gain a +1 item bonus to [Survival](/Skills.aspx?ID=16) checks, which increases to a +2 item bonus when you [Sense Direction](/Actions.aspx?ID=64).

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

This bracelet has three charms depicting a dagger, a shield, and a rose. While wearing this bracelet, you gain a +1 item bonus to [Thievery](/Skills.aspx?ID=50) checks. Whenever you roll a success to free someone from manacles, it counts as two successes (three on a critical success).

>
[Shadewither Key](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1818)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Gatewalkers</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Unique" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=161" />
<trait label="Artifact" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=253" />
<trait label="Cursed" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=274" />
<trait label="Illusion" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=92" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Primal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=134" />
<trait label="Shadow" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=143" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #187: The Seventh Arch](/Sources.aspx?ID=192) pg. 79

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This palm-sized talisman hangs on a string of braided bark fibers. It resembles a leaf from some unknown tree similar to oak, carved from jade and then dipped halfway into black ink that looks wet despite feeling completely dry. The gate key was originally created to open the aiudara known as the _Seventh Arch_. In recent years, corrupting magic has given it additional, stranger powers.

 When you wear and invest _the Shadewither Key_, shadows gather around you. You gain a +1 item bonus to [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) checks. However, this boon comes with great risk: any [elf](/Traits.aspx?ID=58) who touches _the Shadewither Key_ is immediately afflicted with the [_obnubilate curse_](/Curses.aspx?ID=49).

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> Interact;     **Effect** You touch _the Shadewither Key_ and command the shadows it casts around you to peel away. The shadows form an umbral double that resembles you in every way except for its fiery red eyes and the expression of wicked delight on its face. The double occupies the same space as you and attempts to intercept any attacks aimed at you. A creature must succeed at a DC 11 flat check when targeting you with an attack, spell, or other effect; on a failure, they hit the shadowy double instead of you. The effect lasts for 1 minute or until the double is hit, whichever comes first. Once the double is hit, it's destroyed. As long as the double exists, you don't gain _the Shadewither Key's_ item bonus to Stealth checks.

**Destruction** _The Shadewither Key's_ magic can be destroyed by exposing the artifact to uncontained teleportation energies. If touched to an unlinked or malfunctioning _aiudara_, _the Shadewither Key_ causes the gate to connect to a new counterpart. If this happens, the key's magic leaves it, rendering the item useless.

</column>

>
[Shadow Ash](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1723)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Blood Lords</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=137" />
<trait label="Catalyst" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=396" />
<trait label="Cold" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=27" />
<trait label="Consumable" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=36" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Necromancy" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=117" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #184: The Ghouls Hunger](/Sources.aspx?ID=147) pg. 81

**Price** 750 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">
<row gap="tiny"><row>**Activate**</row><row>Cast a Spell or successfully perform a ritual as the primary or secondary caster</row></row>

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This small pile of ash glows with strange blue embers that coat whatever they touch with a thin layer of frost laced with veins of necrotic ichor. Adding this catalyst to an [_animate dead_](/Spells.aspx?ID=666) spell or [_create undead_](/Rituals.aspx?ID=10) ritual wreathes the resulting [undead](/Traits.aspx?ID=160) creature in a shroud of frost that pulses with negative energy. During a combat encounter, the first opponent to deal damage to the undead creature with a melee Strike takes 3d6 cold damage and becomes [drained 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=10) as the shroud of ice and rot shatters from the blow. If the undead creature survives the encounter, the shroud of frost reforms the next day. When an undead creature animated or created with this catalyst dies, it can return to animation with half of its Hit Points within 1d4 rounds of its death (unless it was killed in a manner that destroys it remains completely such as a [_disintegrate_](/Spells.aspx?ID=76) spell) with a DC 11 flat check. If the undead creature rises again, a desperate, garbled screech resonates from within its corpse.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

>
[Shadow Manse](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1717)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Blood Lords</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=137" />
<trait label="Conjuration" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=33" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Structure" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=153" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #183: Field of Maidens](/Sources.aspx?ID=145) pg. 76

**Price** 1,550 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Bulk** 1 when not activated
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This miniature dollhouse is made of dark wood with steep eaves and wide windows. Close inspection through the open windows reveals the inside to be elaborately decorated with fine furniture and ebony accoutrements.

**Activate** <actions string="" /> 1 minute (command, envision, Interact);     **Effect** You cause the dollhouse to grow into a mansion, 60 feet across and 20 feet high, with a dozen rooms. The mansion [pushes aside](/Rules.aspx?ID=451) rather than traps creatures in the area when it is created. The door appears in front of you; it bears no lock and provides easy entrance to anyone. The mansion's interior is well-appointed and dimly lit via wall sconces and fireplaces that emit pale, heatless flames. Each day at dusk, the mansion's dining room produces enough fine food and water to sustain the creatures in the manor at that time. Except for this nourishment, everything inside the manor is nearly impossible to break; even the flimsiest chairs and thinnest draperies have Hardness 20. The material inside the mansion vanishes if removed, but is replaced with the next activation.

 Although the mansion is easy for anyone to enter, only you and other creatures you designate when you activate the manor can leave it. Others find themselves entering some other part of the mansion when they leave through a door or window, rather than exiting. A creature that succeeds at a DC 30 [Occultism](/Skills.aspx?ID=11) check when attempting to exit the mansion can leave it if they choose, as can anyone who [Forces Open](/Actions.aspx?ID=34) an exit with a successful DC 30 [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) check; any opening they make in the mansion closes behind them.

 You can return the _shadow manse_ to its dollhouse form by twisting the front door handle and uttering a command (as a single action). Once deactivated, it can't be reactivated for 8 hours.

</column>

</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Blood Lords</spoilers>

**Source** [Pathfinder #185: A Taste of Ashes](/Sources.aspx?ID=188) pg. 79

**Price** 23,000 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Bulk** L

---

This _+3 [greater striking](/Equipment.aspx?ID=280) [kukri](/Weapons.aspx?ID=56)_ has a thin, delicate blade that absorbs light.

**Activate** <actions string="" /> Interact ([illusion](/Traits.aspx?ID=92), [teleportation](/Traits.aspx?ID=156)) **Frequency** one per day;   **Effect** You make a melee Strike with _shadow's heart_ and teleport to an open space you can see within 100 feet. If the attack hits, you also leave behind a shadowy, illusory duplicate of yourself that attacks the same target for up to 3 rounds. The illusion has 1 action per round, which it takes on the turn it's created and on your turn each round. It uses this action to move up to 30 feet to a square adjacent to the target and (if the target is adjacent) to attack the target with a +28 attack modifier, dealing 3d6+16 slashing damage. The illusion has an AC of 35 and is immediately destroyed by any attack that deals damage or requires a saving throw.

<title
    level="1"

>
[Shadowed Scale, the Jungle Secret](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1530)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Strength of Thousands</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Unique" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=161" />
<trait label="Artifact" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=253" />
<trait label="Conjuration" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=33" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Primal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=134" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #174: Shadows of the Ancients](/Sources.aspx?ID=115) pg. 77

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn mask

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This gold-inlaid wooden mask depicts the reptilian visage of a [mokele-mbembe](/Monsters.aspx?ID=1230), a jungle predator seen by the Mwangi as embodiments of nature's strength and majesty. If you're a Magaambyan who already has a mask, you can use _Shadowed Scale, the Jungle Secret_ in lieu of your own mask for the purposes of mask-related abilities, such as [Magic Warrior Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=903). When you wear the mask, you are always [concealed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=4) while in a jungle.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> envision;    **Requirements** Your last action was a melee Strike that killed a living creature or destroyed an [undead](/Traits.aspx?ID=160) creature; **Effect** You cause the body to decompose into a pile of fertile soil. The creature's body is completely destroyed at the start of your next turn, and it can only be returned to life with the use of powerful magic such as [_miracle_](/Spells.aspx?ID=196) or [_wish_](/Spells.aspx?ID=377).

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> Interact;  **Frequency** once per hour;  **Requirements** You are adjacent to the body of a creature you killed that has decomposed into soil; **Effect** You pull a seed from the mask and throw it into the soil, where it sprouts. You cast [_summon plant or fungus_](/Spells.aspx?ID=325); the spell is heightened to a level equal to one-half of the slain creature's level, rounded up. When the spell's duration ends, the plant creature returns to the soil, where it roots itself and becomes a non-creature piece of flora.

**Destruction** If the progenitor of all mokele-mbembes stomps on the mask, it is crushed to splinters.

</column>

This black cape flows more like a vaporous liquid than fabric. The cape grants you a +3 item bonus to [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) checks. When you invest the cape, you either increase your Dexterity modifier by 1 or increase it to +4, whichever would give you a higher value

If you roll a success, you're [hidden](/Conditions.aspx?ID=22) from that creature until the end of your next turn or until right after you use a [hostile action](/Rules.aspx?ID=300) against that creature. If you roll a critical success, you're hidden from that creature until the end of your next turn, even if you use hostile actions against that creature.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** With a twirl of the cape, you transform yourself into a puff of gray smoke. You cast [_vapor form_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1738) on yourself.

<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 23"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Shadowpiercer](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3510)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Unique" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=723" />
<trait label="Artifact" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=537" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=644" />
<trait label="Mythic" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=835" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [War of Immortals](/Sources.aspx?ID=232) pg. 152

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** 1
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Base Weapon** [Spear](/Weapons.aspx?ID=365)
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Muted, silvery moonlight gleams along the curved blade of this _[+4](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2830) [major striking](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2861) [ghost touch](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2840) [spear](/Weapons.aspx?ID=365)_. Braided tassels of horsehair dangle from its sturdy haft, and archaic runes in Nidalese script shimmer along the weapon in the presence of shadow magic.

_Shadowpiercer_ ignores [immunity](/Rules.aspx?ID=2312) and [resistance](/Rules.aspx?ID=2318) to precision damage of creatures with the [incorporeal](/Traits.aspx?ID=632) or [shadow](/Traits.aspx?ID=693) trait, and deals an additional 2d6 precision damage to such creatures. While wielding _Shadowpiercer_, you gain a +2 status bonus to saving throws against [darkness](/Traits.aspx?ID=569) and shadow effects; this bonus also applies to allies within 60 feet of you while you wield the spear.

If you are a worshipper of [Zon-Kuthon](/Deities.aspx?ID=296), you are [drained](/Conditions.aspx?ID=68) 4 and [enfeebled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=71) 4 while carrying or wielding _Shadowpiercer_. If you use a darkness or shadow effect while carrying or wielding _Shadowpiercer_, you become enfeebled 4; this condition’s value reduces by 1 at the start of each day you do not have physical contact with _Shadowpiercer_.

**Activate—Absorb Shadows** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [healing](/Traits.aspx?ID=623), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645), [occult](/Traits.aspx?ID=662)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You touch _Shadowpiercer_ to a [darkness](/Traits.aspx?ID=569) or [shadow](/Traits.aspx?ID=693) effect to siphon its energy and bolster yourself. You gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to four times the effect’s [counteract](/Rules.aspx?ID=2250) rank. These temporary Hit Points last for 1 hour. In addition, if the effect is causing darkness, that darkness is automatically counteracted within 15 feet of you for as long as you have those temporary Hit Points. This doesn’t provide light—it merely restores the area to its natural illumination level.

**Activate—Rebuff Gloom** <actions string="Reaction" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [occult](/Traits.aspx?ID=662)) **Frequency** You don’t currently have the [drained](/Conditions.aspx?ID=68) condition; **Trigger** You or an ally within 60 feet is targeted by a [darkness](/Traits.aspx?ID=569) or [shadow](/Traits.aspx?ID=693) effect;  **Effect** Spend a [Mythic Point](/Rules.aspx?ID=3320); the spear drains your vitality to [counteract](/Rules.aspx?ID=2250) the effect. You can attempt to counteract the effect (+46 modifier level, counteract rank 10). You can activate this effect without having a Mythic Point available but doing so makes you [drained](/Conditions.aspx?ID=68) 2.

**Destruction** _Shadowpiercer_ simply disappears if a worshipper of [Zon-Kuthon](/Deities.aspx?ID=296) casts a 10th-rank [_darkness_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1480) spell on it once a day for an entire month while it is unattended.

</column>

fields.text: Item 23 Shadowpiercer Unique Artifact Magical Mythic Source War of Immortals pg. 152 Usage held in 1 hand Bulk 1 Base Weapon Spear Muted, silvery moonlight gleams along the curved blade of this +4 major striking ghost touch spear . Braided tassels of horsehair dangle from its sturdy haft, and archaic runes in Nidalese script shimmer along the weapon in the presence of shadow magic. Shadowpiercer ignores immunity and resistance to precision damage of creatures with the incorporeal or shadow trait, and deals an additional 2d6 precision damage to such creatures. While wielding Shadowpiercer , you gain a +2 status bonus to saving throws against darkness and shadow effects; this bonus also applies to allies within 60 feet of you while you wield the spear. If you are a worshipper of Zon-Kuthon, you are drained 4 and enfeebled 4 while carrying or wielding Shadowpiercer . If you use a darkness or shadow effect while carrying or wielding Shadowpiercer , you become enfeebled 4; this condition’s value reduces by 1 at the start of each day you do not have physical contact with Shadowpiercer . Activate—Absorb Shadows Two Actions (concentrate, healing, manipulate, occult) Frequency once per day; Effect You touch Shadowpiercer to a darkness or shadow effect to siphon its energy and bolster yourself. You gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to four times the effect’s counteract rank. These temporary Hit Points last for 1 hour. In addition, if the effect is causing darkness, that darkness is automatically counteracted within 15 feet of you for as long as you have those temporary Hit Points. This doesn’t provide light—it merely restores the area to its natural illumination level. Activate—Rebuff Gloom Reaction (concentrate, occult) Frequency You don’t currently have the drained condition; Trigger You or an ally within 60 feet is targeted by a darkness or shadow effect; Effect Spend a Mythic Point; the spear drains your vitality to counteract the effect. You can attempt to counteract the effect (+46 modifier level, counteract rank 10). You can activate this effect without having a Mythic Point available but doing so makes you drained 2. Destruction Shadowpiercer simply disappears if a worshipper of Zon-Kuthon casts a 10th-rank darkness spell on it once a day for an entire month while it is unattended.

A shaping sweet is a gelatinous, fruit-flavored candy that confers a whisper of this ability on you when you eat it. For 1 hour after eating a shaping sweet, you can make each of the following changes to your surroundings with an Interact action. You can make each change only once.
  • **Alter Weather** You create or eliminate minor precipitation in a 30-foot emanation.
  • **Fairy Ring** A ring of flowers and mushrooms appears in a 10-foot burst around you, restoring 1 Hit Point at the start of each of your turns to a randomly chosen fey creature within. The ring lasts for 1 minute.
  • **Foliate Vegetation** grows around you in a 10-foot radius burst, creating light undergrowth that lasts for 1 minute.
  • **Terrain Shift** The ground in your space rises or falls by 5 feet, remaining at that height for 1 minute.

This jagged shard of bone appears to be and functions as a _+1 [striking](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2829) [dagger](/Weapons.aspx?ID=358)_ with a sharp edge that is perpetually stained with blood. Whenever you critically hit with the weapon, you deal an additional 1d6 [persistent bleed damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29), but you also take 1d6 persistent bleed damage. You take a –2 penalty to the flat check to remove this bleed damage, and when you succeed at this flat check, you are exposed to Verex's ruin (see below) as the site of the injury grows red and inflamed, your blood vessels discoloring and swelling as if serrated knives were trying to push their way out.

 Once the curse has activated for the first time, the weapon fuses to you; while you can sheathe the dagger outside of combat, it appears in your hand when a fight begins and you can't sheathe it as long as there is an enemy you can perceive.

This stone fragment from the _Third Seal_ retains a tiny sliver of that legendary item's power. The flame can be covered or hidden, but it can't be smothered or quenched.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> envision, Interact;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** By gripping the shard tightly and waving it before you, you can produce the effects of a [_levitate_](/Spells.aspx?ID=170) spell on yourself.

---

A _shared-pain sankeit_ seems to be an impressive suit of _+2 [resilient](/Equipment.aspx?ID=279) [fortification](/Equipment.aspx?ID=285) [duskwood](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2918) [sankeit](/Armor.aspx?ID=34)_ shaped to resemble a mighty [linnorm](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=69). However, it protects you by drawing on the health of your nearby allies. When you roll the flat check for the armor's _fortification_ rune, it protects you normally when you roll a 20. When you roll a 17, 18, or 19, though, the GM determines damage for the critical hit normally, then distributes half to you and the other half evenly among allies within 30 feet of you. If no ally is within range to take the distributed damage, the _fortification_ rune fails to function. This effect manifests the first time an attacker scores a critical hit on you, after which the armor fuses with you.
