[Soul Chain](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1737)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Crown of the Kobold King</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=137" />
<trait label="Cursed" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=274" />
<trait label="Evocation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=65" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Crown of the Kobold King](/Sources.aspx?ID=148) pg. 117

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 2 hands

**Bulk** 1
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Base Weapon** [Spiked Chain](/Weapons.aspx?ID=60)
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

A soul chain is a _+1 [striking](/Equipment.aspx?ID=280) [spiked chain](/Weapons.aspx?ID=60)_ that has become cursed after a [forge-spurned](/Monsters.aspx?ID=473) used it to kill a creature and trap its soul. In the hands of a forge-spurned, a soul chain inflicts an additional 1d6 fire damage on a hit. Other creatures can use a _soul chain_ as a standard _+1 striking spiked chain_. A _soul chain_ fuses with its wielder the first time the wielder damages a living creature with the weapon. A character who dies while carrying a _soul chain_ must attempt a DC 20 Will save; on a failure, they're immediately transformed into a forge-spurned. Carrying multiple soul chains doesn't increase the DC of the save, but the carrier must attempt the save once for each chain they carry.

<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 15"
    pfs="Limited"
>
[Soulcutter](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3701)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Spore War</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Unique" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=161" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #211: The Secret of Deathstalk Tower](/Sources.aspx?ID=254) pg. 82

**Price** 6,500 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** 2
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Base Weapon** [Elven Curve Blade](/Weapons.aspx?ID=406)
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This _[+2 greater striking ](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2861) [astral ](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2832) [elven curve blade](/Weapons.aspx?ID=406)_ was the treasured weapon of the [Calistrian](/Deities.aspx?ID=279) witch Silisifex, who played several key roles in reclaiming Kyonin from Tanglebriar when the elves returned to Golarion. Although a witch, her mesmerizing skill with the curved blade rivaled that of many soldiers. Her reasons for leaving Soulcutter behind in Kyonin before her final mission into Tanglebriar in an attempt to purify Deathstalk Tower are unknown.

As long as you carry _Soulcutter_, you gain its potency bonus as an item bonus to all saving throws against [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=647) effects. This bonus increases by 2 against [possession](/Traits.aspx?ID=671) effects.

**Activate—Soothe Souls** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [healing](/Traits.aspx?ID=623), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645), [primal](/Traits.aspx?ID=676), [vitality](/Traits.aspx?ID=509)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You whirl _Soulcutter_ in the air around you, rejuvenating the living within a 20-foot [emanation](/Rules.aspx?ID=2387) around you while castigating those in that area who have no place in nature. You can [Sustain](/Actions.aspx?ID=2317) this activation for up to 1 minute. Living creatures that start their turn in the area regain 1d8 Hit Points, and any [fiend](/Traits.aspx?ID=600) or [undead](/Traits.aspx?ID=722) creature that starts its turn in the area takes 1d8 [spirit](/Traits.aspx?ID=737) damage.

**Activate—Soulcutting Storm** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645), [primal](/Traits.aspx?ID=676)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You swing _Soulcutter_ and cast a 7th-rank [_weapon storm_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1758) to your specifications, but all damage caused by the spell is spirit damage. If used to damage a creature that’s possessing another creature, this spell does no damage to the possessed creature.

</column>

You can Sustain this activation for up to 1 minute. Living creatures that start their turn in the area regain 1d8 Hit Points, and any fiend or undead creature that starts its turn in the area takes 1d8 spirit damage. Activate—Soulcutting Storm Two Actions (concentrate, manipulate, primal) Frequency once per day; Effect You swing Soulcutter and cast a 7th-rank weapon storm to your specifications, but all damage caused by the spell is spirit damage. If used to damage a creature that’s possessing another creature, this spell does no damage to the possessed creature.

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Perception** +34; precise [low-light vision](/Rules.aspx?ID=2411) and hearing within 30 feet

**Communication** [telepathy](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=79) (partner only)

**Skills** [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=43) +34, [Religion](/Skills.aspx?ID=46) +34, [Survival](/Skills.aspx?ID=49) +34

**Int** +7, **Wis** +6, **Cha** +5

**Will** +34 

</column>

---        

The echo of the [Calistrian](/Deities.aspx?ID=279) witch Silisifex imbues her legendary blade with a shimmering pale-green glow equivalent to that of candlelight; _Soulcutter_ can activate or deactivate this radiance as a free action once per round on her partner’s turn. _Soulcutter’s_ telepathic voice is a sultry whisper that often infuses her observations with a flirtatious edge or a biting sense of dark humor. 

_Soulcutter_ is a _[+3 major striking ](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2861) [greater astral ](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2832) [holy ](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2842) [elven curve blade](/Weapons.aspx?ID=406)_. As long as you carry _Soulcutter_, you gain her potency bonus as an item bonus to all saving throws against mental effects. This bonus increases by 2 to +5 against [possession](/Traits.aspx?ID=671) effects.

**Activate—Soothe Souls** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [healing](/Traits.aspx?ID=623), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645), [vitality](/Traits.aspx?ID=509)) **Frequency** once per hour;   **Effect** _Soulcutter_ creates a pulse of restorative energy, rejuvenating those within a 30-foot [emanation](/Rules.aspx?ID=2387) around you while castigating those in that area who have no place in nature. _Soulcutter_ can [Sustain](/Actions.aspx?ID=2317) this activation for up to 1 minute. Living creatures that start their turn in the area regain 2d8 Hit Points, and any [fiend](/Traits.aspx?ID=600) or [undead](/Traits.aspx?ID=722) creature that starts their turn in the area takes 2d8 [spirit](/Traits.aspx?ID=737) damage (DC 38 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=2297) Will save).

**Activate—Soulcutting Storm** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645), [spirit](/Traits.aspx?ID=737)) **Frequency** once per hour;   **Effect** _Soulcutter_ casts a 9th-rank [_weapon storm_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1758) to your specification, but all damage caused by the spell is [spirit](/Traits.aspx?ID=737) damage. If used to damage a creature that’s possessing another creature, this spell does no damage to the possessed creature.

**Activate—Shame Demon** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561))    **Effect** _Soulcutter_ targets a [demon](/Traits.aspx?ID=573) she can see or hear within 30 feet, causing the blade’s green light to well up around the demon for a moment. The demon suffers the effects of its sin vulnerability, if it has any, and is then temporarily immune to Shame Demon for 24 hours. If _Soulcutter’s_ partner wasn’t aware of the normal effects that trigger that demon’s sin vulnerability, they learn it at this time.

_Nethys Note: the non-artifact version of the item is [here.](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3701) This artifact's heroic legacy, and its subsequent skills and ability attribute, are presented [here](/Rules.aspx?ID=3419). _

<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 17"
    pfs="Limited"
>
[Soulfeeding Mask](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3641)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Curtain Call</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=137" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Unholy" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=521" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #205: Singer, Stalker, Skinsaw Man](/Sources.aspx?ID=246) pg. 85

**Price** 15,000 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn mask

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This unsettling mask is made from different flensed faces that have been stitched together with bright red thread. Wearing a _soulfeeding mask_ allows you to see others’ souls within their bodies as long as they’re within 60 feet, as if under the effects of [_see the unseen_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1663) and [_truesight_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1727) (but only against living or [undead](/Traits.aspx?ID=722) creatures). Your [Perception](/Rules.aspx?ID=2298) DC increases by 10 against living creatures who [Impersonate](/Actions.aspx?ID=2388) undead creatures or against undead creatures who Impersonate living creatures, as you can tell if the creature’s soul has been affected by undeath. The _soulfeeding mask’s_ [counteract](/Rules.aspx?ID=2250) rank is 9, with a counteract modifier of +31. 

While wearing a _soulfeeding mask_, you gain [darkvision](/Rules.aspx?ID=2410). 

If you’re [holy](/Traits.aspx?ID=517), you’re [enfeebled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=71) 2 while you have a _soulfeeding_ mask [invested](/Traits.aspx?ID=637).

**Activate—Devour Soul** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [death](/Traits.aspx?ID=571), [void](/Traits.aspx?ID=510)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** The _soulfeeding mask’s_ eyes and jaw open wide, and clouds of darkness and shadow spill out and attempt to engulf a single creature you can see that’s within 30 feet. That creature takes 50 [void](/Traits.aspx?ID=510) damage with a DC 36 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=2247) Fortitude save. If the target is undead or otherwise has [void healing](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=83), this activation loses the death and void traits and gains the vitality trait, and the target takes 50 [vitality](/Traits.aspx?ID=509) damage with a DC 36 basic Fortitude save. If the target takes any damage, you become [quickened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=89) 1 for 1 minute and can use the extra action each round for only [Stride](/Actions.aspx?ID=2305) actions, unless the damage killed the creature, in which case you can also use the extra action each round for [Strike](/Actions.aspx?ID=2306) actions as well.

**Activate—Disgorge Soul** <actions string="Three Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561))   **Requirements** You’re quickened as a result of Devour Soul; **Effect** The _soulfeeding mask_ disgorges the devoured soul. You’re no longer quickened from Devour Soul, and the soulfeeding mask casts [_duplicate foe_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1505) (DC 36 Fortitude save) to your specifications, targeting the creature whose soul had been devoured. You must [Sustain this effect](/Actions.aspx?ID=2631), unless the target creature was slain by Devour Soul, in which case duplicate foe functions as if the creature had failed its save, and the _soulfeeding mask_ Sustains this spell automatically.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>
